question: What is the regulatory driver behind demand for Diginex's products?

beats.line: The rules on ESG reporting have shifted in the past eighteen to twenty-four months.
beats.headline: 18–24 MONTHS
beats.action: A halftone stack of paper rulebooks drops onto a cream chip and settles square to the frame.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] The rules on ESG reporting have shifted in the past eighteen to twenty-four months.

connector.to: a grid of paper company cards

beats.line: Europe's reporting directive asks around fifty thousand large companies for detailed ESG metrics from twenty twenty-five.
beats.headline: ~50,000 COMPANIES
subjects: a grid of paper company cards
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the rulebook stack fans open into a grid of paper company cards; an orange paper ribbon runs from the rulebook stack to the grid, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '~50,000' sits beside the ribbon, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [excited] Europe's reporting directive asks around fifty thousand large companies for detailed ESG metrics from twenty twenty-five.

connector.to: a grid of paper company cards

beats.line: That directive is the single largest driver of demand for ESG software globally.
beats.headline: LARGEST DRIVER
subjects: a grid of paper company cards
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the card grid tilts and stacks into one tall column beside the rulebook stack, the orange ribbon still in place between them.
beats.delivery: That directive is the single largest driver of demand for ESG software globally.

connector.to: a grid of paper company cards

beats.line: America's climate rule is delayed and contested. Still, climate data must become auditable and consistent.
beats.headline: SEC CLIMATE RULE
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the card column unfolds flat into the folded paper map; a paper filing document lands on it and holds.
beats.delivery: America's climate rule is delayed and contested. Still, climate data must become auditable and consistent.

beats.line: Companies working across jurisdictions face fragmented requirements. Global standards work aims to standardise them.
beats.headline: FRAGMENTED RULES
beats.action: The previous chip slides left as the folded paper map tears into scattered panels, then a paper platform slab slides under them; an orange paper string runs from the map to the slab.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Companies working across jurisdictions face fragmented requirements. Global standards work aims to standardise them.

beats.line: Diginex's supply chain module addresses Europe's disclosure rules and the UK Modern Slavery Act.
beats.headline: SUPPLY CHAIN
subjects: a chain of paper supply cards
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the paper platform slab sprouts a chain of paper supply cards; a paper hand enters and presses the chain flat, the orange string still running to the slab.
beats.delivery: Diginex's supply chain module addresses Europe's disclosure rules and the UK Modern Slavery Act.

beats.line: Larger competitors ride the same regulatory wave, and they have deeper resources.
beats.headline: DEEPER RESOURCES
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the paper chain folds up into a paper bar chart with two tall bars; a paper window frame drops in beside it and a black arrow runs from the chart to the frame.
beats.delivery: Larger competitors ride the same regulatory wave, and they have deeper resources.

beats.line: Diginex must prove platform traction and cross-sell before that regulatory window closes.
beats.headline: WINDOW CLOSES
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the paper window frame slides shut over the bar chart and stops half open, the black arrow still pointing at it.
beats.delivery: Diginex must prove platform traction and cross-sell before that regulatory window closes.

beats.line: The regulatory tailwind is real and durable. These mandates are not going away.
beats.headline: DURABLE TAILWIND
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the paper window frame curls over into a paper wave; the rulebook stack rises behind it and a cream ribbon runs from the stack to the wave.
beats.delivery: The regulatory tailwind is real and durable. These mandates are not going away.

beats.line: Diginex isn't betting on voluntary adoption. It is riding a regulatory wave.
beats.headline: RIDING THE WAVE
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the paper wave flattens back under the rulebook stack, which settles onto a cream chip with the cream ribbon now taped across it.
beats.delivery: Diginex isn't betting on voluntary adoption. It is riding a regulatory wave.
